summary: @servicetitan/contentful preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases and then executes the sibling file `math_init.js` under Bun via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a single-line 727 KB bundle marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` using a rotated string array (`WV8StW` rotator over `n7gIxM`) and a custom base94 alphabet decoder — the contents are not human-readable and no plain source is shipped. Using an alternate runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated bundle causes the payload to run outside the Node-oriented tooling installers typically monitor. The behavior fires unconditionally on `npm install` and is unrelated to the package's stated purpose (a Contentful helper library). The package publishes under the `@servicetitan` scope with a repo URL of `servicetitan/anvil-uikit-contrib`, presenting as an internal ServiceTitan module and lending the install-time dropper additional credibility.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
